concept.internal_detail: interlocking brass gears and fine helical hairsprings
concept.button: a small raised steel pin on the lower rim
concept.shell_mechanic: The cylindrical casing splits longitudinally along its fluted grooves and the halves rotate apart on internal pivots
concept.emerging_parts: Five segmented copper rings and a pair of delicate wire antennae
concept.signature_move: its segmented brass rings ripple forward along their pivots in a rhythmic wave and its wire antennae sweep once from left to right
concept.turkish: Deniz solucani (deniz tabaninda yasayan, halkali, yumusak govceli omurgasiz) — oluklu silindirik makara, patinajli bronz ve mavilendirilmis celik
